items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Red invited me to come sit in one time, which I did, and everybody liked it so Ben, in effect, hired me... so I got to work with Ben Webster.

ctx.x: I was just kind of curious about the lifestyle in that time in California.
Oh, I see, and Ben Webster, yeah.
What, what it was like. What you were all like then. What you were doing. What you were aspiring to. (overlapping/inaudible)
